# What a user does and sees (compat/apps.rs): each case after its tap.
# props-gesture-values
tap id:case-props-gesture-values
expect Card
# Drags drive the values on both axes, each told apart by where it starts.
prop id:card pan x=11 y=22
noprop id:card pinch
noprop id:card rotation
# On one axis.
prop id:sheet pan y=33
# Pinches drive the scale, rotations the angle.
prop id:photo pinch scale=1.5
prop id:photo rotation angle=45
noprop id:photo pan
covers [props] pan
covers [props] pinch
covers [props] rotation
# props-input-config
tap id:case-props-input-config
# for each input.

prop id:keys autoCapitalize none
prop id:plain autoCapitalize sentences
prop id:keys autoCorrect false

prop id:plain autoComplete default
prop id:short maxLength 4
noprop id:plain maxLength
prop id:submit submitBehavior submit
noprop id:plain submitBehavior
prop id:focused autoFocus true
prop id:plain autoFocus false
prop id:focused caret false
prop id:plain caret true
# `defaultValue`: the initial text.
prop id:initial value Hello
noprop id:plain value
expect Name: Ada
# `value`: what the app sets, also after an edit.
prop id:controlled value Ada
type id:controlled x
expect Name: ADAX
prop id:controlled value ADAX
tap id:reset
expect Name: Grace
prop id:controlled value Grace

# props-list-events
tap id:case-props-list-events
expect Feed 0
expect Ends: 0
# 20 items of 40 points in 200: 600 points to scroll. A viewport from the
# end is not within the threshold's fifth of one (40 points); 10 points
# from it is.
scroll scroll:text:"Feed 0" 0 420
absent Ends: 1
scroll scroll:text:"Feed 12" 0 590
expect Ends: 1
# A pull to refresh: the app shows it refreshing until it is done.
prop scroll:text:"Feed 19" refreshing false
event scroll:text:"Feed 19" onRefresh
expect Refreshes: 1
prop scroll:text:"Feed 19" refreshing true
tap id:done
prop scroll:text:"Feed 19" refreshing false
# Starts at item 5, 200 points down, with the keys `keyExtractor` gives.
prop scroll:text:"Jump 5" contentOffset y=200
expect Jump 5
expect Keys: k5,k6,k7
covers [props] List.loadMoreThreshold
covers [events] onLoadMore
covers [events] onRefresh
covers [props] refreshing
covers [props] List.initialScrollIndex
covers [props] List.keyExtractor
covers [events] List.onViewableItemsChange
# props-list-follow
tap id:case-props-list-follow
expect Feed 0
# At the end of its 10 items (400 points in 200), an item added below
# keeps the list at the end.
scroll scroll:text:"Feed 0" 0 200
tap id:add
prop scroll:text:"Feed 9" contentOffset y=240
# Fully visible items only count as viewable: 0 and 1 of the 100 points,
# not 2, half shown.
expect Viewable: 0,1
covers [props] maintainVisibleContentPosition
covers [props] viewabilityConfig
covers [events] List.onViewableItemsChange
# props-list-layout
tap id:case-props-list-layout
# Two columns: item 1 beside item 0, item 2 below them.
expect Grid 0
frame id:grid-1 0 0 195 40
origin id:grid-0 0 64
origin id:grid-1 195 64
origin id:grid-2 0 104
# From the end: item 0 last, at the bottom, and the list starts scrolled to
# the end.
expect Chat 0
origin id:chat-0 0 544
origin id:chat-2 0 464
prop scroll:text:"Chat 0" contentOffset y=200
# Items 0 and 3 stick to the top while scrolled past, item 3 pushing item
# 0 out.
expect Sticky 0
prop scroll:text:"Sticky 0" stickyHeaderIndices start=0 end=80, start=120 end=Infinity
# Items not measured yet count 100 points each: 30 items are 3000 tall.
scroll scroll:text:"Estimated 0" 0 10
expect Content: 3000
covers [props] numColumns
covers [props] inverted
covers [props] stickyHeaderIndices
covers [props] estimatedItemSize

# props-scroll-behavior
tap id:case-props-scroll-behavior
expect Done
# How the first scroll view scrolls, as the platform receives it.
prop id:paged pagingEnabled true
prop id:paged snapToInterval 80
prop id:paged snapToOffsets 0, 150, 300
prop id:paged snapToAlignment center
prop id:paged decelerationRate 0.99
prop id:paged bounces false
prop id:paged contentInset top=8 bottom=16
prop id:paged contentOffset y=40
prop id:paged keyboardShouldPersistTaps handled
prop id:paged disableIntervalMomentum true
prop id:paged scrollbar false
prop id:paged keyboardDismissMode on-drag
prop id:paged horizontal false
prop id:paged scrollable true
prop id:paged refreshing true
# The spinner stops when the app says so.
tap id:done
prop id:paged refreshing false
# The second scrolls sideways, not by the user.
prop id:sideways horizontal true
prop id:sideways scrollable false
prop id:sideways decelerationRate 0.5
prop id:sideways scrollbar true
prop id:sideways bounces true
prop id:sideways contentInset {}
noprop id:sideways contentOffset
# The third reports a scroll at most every 3 seconds: the second scroll
# shows only once that has passed.
expect Scrolled: none
scroll id:throttled 0 100
expect Scrolled: 100
scroll id:throttled 0 200
absent Scrolled: 200
expect Scrolled: 100
expect Scrolled: 200
prop id:throttled contentOffset y=200

# props-refresh-indicator
tap id:case-props-refresh-indicator
expect Pull me
# The app's indicator, 72 tall, takes the spinner's place; the pull feeds
# the animated value the app made (created at 3).
prop id:pull refreshIndicator height=72
prop id:pull pullValue 3
listens id:pull onRefresh
# A list passes it to its scroll view.
prop scroll:text:"Row 0" refreshIndicator height=60
# Without a height there is no indicator: the platform's spinner stays.
noprop id:none refreshIndicator
covers [props] pullValue
covers [props] refreshIndicator

# props-media-image-variants
tap id:case-props-media-image-variants
# An imported image with @2x and @3x files loads the file for the
# screen's pixel ratio, as a source and as a placeholder, and keeps the
# imported file's size in points.
prop id:flag src asset:/images/flag.png
prop id:remote placeholder asset:/images/flag.png
frame id:flag 0 64 4 3
pixelratio 3
prop id:flag src asset:/images/flag@3x.png
prop id:remote placeholder asset:/images/flag@3x.png
pixelratio 2
prop id:flag src asset:/images/flag@2x.png
prop id:remote placeholder asset:/images/flag@2x.png
frame id:flag 0 64 4 3
# Back to the start's ratio, for the cases after this one.
pixelratio 1
prop id:flag src asset:/images/flag.png
covers [props] src
covers [props] placeholder
# props-media-image-inline
tap id:case-props-media-image-inline
# A data: URI (base64, and percent-encoded as the placeholder) and a blob:
# URL show their bytes. The platforms get them under a key of the core's
# own, which no app sees and which may change between releases, so no
# step here names it (the engine's `images` tests check it).
# The upload finished: the remote URL replaces the local preview, and the
# blob's URL is revoked.
tap id:uploaded
prop id:preview src https://example.com/photo.png
covers [props] src
covers [globals] URL
covers [globals] Blob
# props-list-start
tap id:case-props-list-start
# Opens at its start: not an approach.
expect Item 0
expect Starts: 0
# 20 items of 40 points in 200. Away from the start, then back: 100
# points from it is not within the threshold's quarter of a viewport (50
# points, not the default whole one); 40 points is.
scroll scroll:text:"Item 0" 0 300
absent Starts: 1
scroll scroll:text:"Item 9" 0 100
absent Starts: 1
scroll scroll:text:"Item 9" 0 40
expect Starts: 1
# Five items arrive above: the rows on screen keep their place, 200
# points further down, out of the threshold, so nothing more loads.
expect Item -4
prop scroll:text:"Item 0" contentOffset y=240
absent Starts: 2
covers [props] List.loadMoreAtStartThreshold
covers [events] onLoadMoreAtStart
# props-list-sticky-offset
tap id:case-props-list-sticky-offset
# Items 0 and 3 stick 24 points below the top: each moves with the scroll
# from 24 points before its position, and item 3 pushes item 0 out when it
# reaches item 0's bottom there.
expect Offset 0
prop scroll:text:"Offset 0" stickyHeaderIndices start=-24 end=56, start=96 end=Infinity
# An animated offset: the platform adds its value as it pins, every frame,
# so the travel is the one at the top.
prop scroll:text:"Animated 0" stickyHeaderIndices start=0 end=80, start=120 end=Infinity
covers [props] stickyHeaderOffset
# props-list-viewport
tap id:case-props-list-viewport
# The list lies below the header at its full length (200 rows of 40) and
# shows its rows from its start to the viewport's end and a screen more.
expect Row 0
expect Row 34
absent Row 35
frame id:rows 0 300 390 8000
# Row 0 sticks to the page's top from the list's start (300) until row 50
# pushes it out; the page pins it, in its offsets.
prop scroll:text:"Row 1" stickyHeaderIndices start=300 end=2260
# The page scrolls it: 5000 down, the rows 4700 into it show.
scroll id:page 0 5000
expect Row 120
origin id:row-120 0 5100
absent Row 160
covers [props] viewport
